lines.zh: 翅膀拍两下，我贴着夜色滑出去。
lines.en: Two wingbeats, and I slide out along the night.

lines.zh: 爪尖刮过石面，我抬高半格。
lines.en: My claws rake the stone; I climb half a notch.

lines.zh: 蜂巢的味道在前面，我拐了个弯。
lines.en: The hive smell is ahead, so I bank around.

lines.zh: 我飞得低，随时能扎下去。
lines.en: I fly low, ready to drop at any moment.

lines.zh: 甲壳在风里咔咔响，像旧门轴。
lines.en: My chitin clicks in the wind like an old hinge.

lines.zh: 绕一圈，再绕一圈，找落单的影子。
lines.en: One lap, another lap, hunting a lone shadow.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我已经绕到你背后。
lines.en: Don't look up; I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 爵士的石柱太密，我得侧着翅膀过。
lines.en: The jazz pillars are thick; I fly on edge.

lines.zh: 回声在洞里弹回来，我听见你了。
lines.en: My echo bounces off the cave and finds you.

lines.zh: 飞高一点，风把我的叫声吹散。
lines.en: Higher now; the wind tears my cry apart.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过草尖，虫子四散逃开。
lines.en: My wings sweep the grass tips and the bugs scatter.

lines.zh: 我在半空停了一瞬，又往前扑。
lines.en: I hover for a heartbeat, then lunge forward again.

lines.zh: 这片的夜风咸，说明石壁不远。
lines.en: This night wind tastes of salt, so the cliffs are near.

lines.zh: 顺着蜂巢的甜味，我找回巢的路。
lines.en: Following the hive's sweetness, I find my way home.

lines.zh: 我从石柱之间穿过去，翅尖没碰。
lines.en: I thread between the pillars without a wingtip touching.

lines.zh: 风往上走，我借它升了一格。
lines.en: The wind rises; I ride it up a block.

lines.zh: 我挂在石缝里，翅膀收成薄纸。
lines.en: I hang in a stone crack, wings folded to thin paper.

lines.zh: 倒挂着睡，血才不会往头上涌。
lines.en: I sleep upside down so the blood stays off my head.

lines.zh: 耳朵在动，洞里的沙粒都在响。
lines.en: My ears twitch; every grain of sand is loud.

lines.zh: 舔一舔爪上的甲壳，还是硬的。
lines.en: I lick the chitin on my claws; still hard.

lines.zh: 这洞里太静，我哼了一声试探。
lines.en: Too quiet here; I squeak once to test it.

lines.zh: 蜂巢块卡在牙缝里，我嚼了半天。
lines.en: A chunk of hive is stuck in my teeth; I chew.

lines.zh: 数着石壁上的裂纹，我等天黑。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the wall and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 有小东西在爬，我装作没看见。
lines.en: Something small is crawling; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩成拳头大的一团。
lines.en: I pull myself into a fist-sized knot.

lines.zh: 风从洞口灌进来，我抖了抖毛。
lines.en: Wind pours through the cave mouth; I shiver.

lines.zh: 歇够了，我磨一磨牙再出去。
lines.en: Rest is over; I sharpen my teeth before heading out.

lines.zh: 夜还没到，我闭眼听自己的心跳。
lines.en: Night is not here yet; I close my eyes and listen.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味太新，像刚从铁匠铺出来。
lines.en: Your iron smell is too new, straight from a smithy.

lines.zh: 站着不动的猎物，我最喜欢。
lines.en: A prey that stands still is my favorite kind.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在暗处发亮，像我。
lines.en: Your eyes shine in the dark, like mine.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰间的剑，先记下。
lines.en: I see the sword at your hip; noted.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在量你肩膀的宽度。
lines.en: Don't blink; I am measuring your shoulders.

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子，像在找一只鸟。
lines.en: You look up like a man hunting a bird.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，你的影子跟着偏。
lines.en: I turn my head aside and your shadow follows.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把让我眼睛发酸。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes my eyes water.

lines.zh: 你往左一步，我的头跟着转。
lines.en: You step left, and my head turns with you.

lines.zh: 这张脸我记住了，别装作路过。
lines.en: I have this face memorized; don't play passerby.

lines.zh: 翼膜破了一道，我飞得晃。
lines.en: A tear in my membrane; my flight wobbles.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还在半空。
lines.en: It hurts, and I am still airborne.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了，里面是软的。
lines.en: My chitin cracked; it is soft underneath.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是旧伤，不算本事。
lines.en: You hit an old scar; no skill in that.

lines.zh: 我的叫声在洞里撞得乱响。
lines.en: My cry rattles around the cave, all wrong.

lines.zh: 翅膀歪了，我照样能扑。
lines.en: The wing is crooked, and I can still beat it.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了一格高度。
lines.en: That blow cost me a notch of altitude.

lines.zh: 洞里回声把我的痛放大了。
lines.en: The cave's echo makes my pain louder.

lines.zh: 别以为流血就会掉下去。
lines.en: Don't assume blood means I fall.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的站位，等一下。
lines.en: I've marked where you stand; wait.

lines.zh: 那是什么味道，甜的，带点蜡。
lines.en: What is that smell? Sweet, a little waxy.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我就飞近一点。
lines.en: Lift it higher and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我要蜂巢。
lines.en: Not bread; I want honeycomb.

lines.zh: 手别抖，我闻得出你的紧张。
lines.en: Steady your hand; I can smell your nerves.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起咬开的壳。
lines.en: This smell recalls the first shell I cracked.

lines.zh: 再晃一晃，我就落到你腕上。
lines.en: Sway it once more and I land on your wrist.

lines.zh: 诱饵太香了，我承认我上钩。
lines.en: The bait is too sweet; I admit I'm hooked.

lines.zh: 你藏着的那块，是不是更甜。
lines.en: The piece you hide, is it sweeter?

lines.zh: 我绕着你的手飞，先闻三圈。
lines.en: I circle your hand and sniff it three times.

lines.zh: 别收回口袋，我还没闻够。
lines.en: Don't put it back in your pocket; I'm not done.

lines.zh: 你顶到我的翼骨了，退半步。
lines.en: You pressed against my wing bone; half a step back.

lines.zh: 你的肩硬，我的爪更硬。
lines.en: Your shoulder is hard; my claws are harder.

lines.zh: 别挤，这洞顶只够一只过。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; this ceiling fits one at a time.

lines.zh: 碰一下就掉粉，你赔不起。
lines.en: One bump and I shed dust you cannot repay.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，你是想被咬吗。
lines.en: This close? Are you asking to be bitten?

lines.zh: 我退半步，是因为懒。
lines.en: I back off half a step from laziness, not fear.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲硌得我耳朵疼。
lines.en: Your armor digs into my ears.

lines.zh: 再推我，我就飞到你头顶。
lines.en: Push me again and I'll fly onto your head.

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，风都乱了。
lines.en: We brushed past; the air is all messed up.

lines.zh: 走路看路，翼膜很薄。
lines.en: Watch where you walk; my wing membrane is thin.

lines.zh: 跟我飞，绕这三根柱子。
lines.en: Fly with me, around these three pillars.

lines.zh: 你的叫声太尖，会吓跑我的。
lines.en: Your call is too shrill; it scares mine away.

lines.zh: 巢里那半边，我一直留着。
lines.en: That half of the nest, I kept it for you.

lines.zh: 翅膀对翅膀，我们就算说好了。
lines.en: Wing to wing, and we have an understanding.

lines.zh: 别碰我的蜂巢，那是给幼崽的。
lines.en: Don't touch my hive; that is for the young.

lines.zh: 倒挂过来，这样才靠得近。
lines.en: Hang upside down here, so we are closer.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守洞，你先睡。
lines.en: We take turns guarding the cave; sleep first.

lines.zh: 你的膜比我的旧，飞得却稳。
lines.en: Your membrane is older than mine, yet steadier.

lines.zh: 等天亮了，我带你看石林。
lines.en: When day comes, I'll show you the stone forest.

lines.zh: 轻轻碰一下翅尖，就够了。
lines.en: Just a touch of wingtips is enough between us.

lines.zh: 地上这块甲壳，我要了。
lines.en: This chitin on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 爪一勾，那块蜂巢就起来了。
lines.en: One hook of the claw and the hive chunk lifts.

lines.zh: 沉是沉，我飞得动。
lines.en: It's heavy, but I can still fly with it.

lines.zh: 这块是我的，我盯了很久。
lines.en: This piece is mine; I've watched it a while.

lines.zh: 这块壳有旧伤，还能用。
lines.en: This shell has an old wound; still usable.

lines.zh: 我用后爪夹着，前爪开路。
lines.en: I hold it in a rear claw; the front ones clear the way.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我得俯冲一次。
lines.en: It slipped; I have to dive for it once.

lines.zh: 地上发亮的东西，一律归我。
lines.en: Anything glinting on the floor belongs to me.

lines.zh: 搬回洞里的，都要码整齐。
lines.en: Whatever I haul to the cave gets stacked neatly.

lines.zh: 这是我今天捡的第三块。
lines.en: This is the third piece I've picked up today.

lines.zh: 草丛动了一下，我立刻转向。
lines.en: The grass shifted once and I turned at once.

lines.zh: 那个背影，从刚才就没挪过。
lines.en: That figure hasn't shifted since a while ago.

lines.zh: 翅膀一僵，我就知道目标在下面。
lines.en: My wings freeze, and I know the target is below.

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏太稳，好追。
lines.en: Your stride is too steady; easy to follow.

lines.zh: 我数到三就俯冲，别乱动。
lines.en: I dive on three, so hold still.

lines.zh: 这味道新鲜，不是昨天那个。
lines.en: This scent is fresh; not the one from yesterday.

lines.zh: 目标在桥那头，我绕过去。
lines.en: The target is past the bridge; I'll go around.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就换成背面。
lines.en: One turn of yours and I take your back.

lines.zh: 洞口卡着个人，正好。
lines.en: Someone is stuck in the cave mouth; perfect.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子先动了一下。
lines.en: I saw your shadow move first.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的爪就张开。
lines.en: One step closer and my claws open.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，一二三四。
lines.en: I count your breaths: one, two, three, four.

lines.zh: 脖子后面最软，我知道。
lines.en: The back of the neck is softest; I know.

lines.zh: 你抬手了，我提前闪开。
lines.en: You raised a hand; I slip aside early.

lines.zh: 绕着飞，让你的剑跟不上。
lines.en: I circle so your sword cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了你就知道角度。
lines.en: I stay silent; a cry would reveal my angle.

lines.zh: 你在护左边，那我就走右边。
lines.en: You guard your left, so I take the right.

lines.zh: 我等你抬手擦汗的那一下。
lines.en: I am waiting for the moment you wipe sweat.

lines.zh: 风声盖住了我的翅膀，很好。
lines.en: The wind covers my wings; good.

lines.zh: 这一扑，我练了整晚。
lines.en: I rehearsed this dive all night.

lines.zh: 俯冲落地，爪子先到。
lines.en: Down I dive, claws arriving first.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在肩甲缝里。
lines.en: This bite goes into the seam of your pauldron.

lines.zh: 六点五的力气，够你记一阵。
lines.en: Six and a half points of force; remember it.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇你的脸，牙跟着来。
lines.en: My wing fans your face and my teeth follow.

lines.zh: 我撞上去又弹开，像颗石子。
lines.en: I slam in and bounce off like a flung pebble.

lines.zh: 你的血味让我更兴奋。
lines.en: The smell of your blood makes me eager.

lines.zh: 抓完就升空，不给你还手。
lines.en: Strike, then climb; no chance to hit back.

lines.zh: 甲壳蹭过铁，火星都出来了。
lines.en: Chitin scrapes iron and sparks come off.

lines.zh: 这一下只是试你的甲。
lines.en: That one was only to test your armor.

lines.zh: 我挂了彩，你也别想好过。
lines.en: I'm cut, but you won't walk away clean.

lines.zh: 石缝裂开，我抖掉身上的灰。
lines.en: The crack widens and I shake the dust off.

lines.zh: 新生的翼膜还软，我先晾一晾。
lines.en: New membrane is still soft; I let it dry.

lines.zh: 这洞的味道我认得，爵士。
lines.en: I know the smell of this cave: jazz.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，石壁全是绿的。
lines.en: First time opening my eyes: the walls are green.

lines.zh: 我从巢里掉下来，正好会飞。
lines.en: I fell from the nest and could already fly.

lines.zh: 头顶有回声，我先叫一声。
lines.en: There's an echo overhead; I call once.

lines.zh: 附近有蜂巢的甜味，运气不错。
lines.en: The hive's sweetness is close by; lucky me.

lines.zh: 翅膀还没干，我先挂在上面。
lines.en: Wings still wet, so I hang up here first.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面我不熟。
lines.en: I don't know this stretch of ground.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片夜色归我巡。
lines.en: From today, I patrol this patch of night.

lines.zh: 翅膀一沾火，膜就卷成纸。
lines.en: One touch of flame and my membrane curls like paper.

lines.zh: 撞在石板上，甲壳先响。
lines.en: I hit the slab and my chitin rings first.

lines.zh: 水灌进翼膜，我扑腾得像布。
lines.en: Water fills my membrane and I flop like cloth.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，翅膀叠成一团。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my wings fold in a knot.

lines.zh: 箭从翼膜穿过去，留个洞。
lines.en: The arrow goes through my wing and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 那股药水味，让骨头都发麻。
lines.en: That potion smell numbs my bones.

lines.zh: 饿久了，叫声细得像丝。
lines.en: Starving long enough, my cry thins to a thread.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，整片翼膜透亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole membrane glows through.

lines.zh: 虚空把我卷走，回声也没了。
lines.en: The void takes me and even my echo is gone.
